sovereign_country.strategic_role: 泛欧数字贸易门户、极速低成本在线设立与新锐EMI银行开户

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial Shipbuilding of Deep-Sea Dry Cargo and Container Vessels

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Partnerships Act 2014 (Bermuda), ss. 1-32, inclusive of the exemptions from stamp duty under the Exempted Partnerships Act and the requirement for an authorised resident representative; Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda) for the corporate general partner vehicle, where applicable
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Registries, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 - Application for Registration of an Exempted Partnership, together with the executed Limited Partnership Agreement and the required statutory declarations
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum contributed capital requirement under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014; capital subscriptions are fixed contractually in the Partnership Agreement and are not subject to escrow deposit, provided the Bermuda Monetary Authority is notified of all beneficial owners within 21 days of registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the admission of the initial Limited Partners and their respective capital subscriptions, as set forth in the Partnership Agreement and recorded in the register of contributions, be and is hereby approved. RESOLVED that the premises situate at the registered office address in Hamilton, Bermuda be and is hereby adopted as the registered office of the Partnership and that the Authorised Representative be appointed to accept service of process. RESOLVED that the General Partner representative be appointed as Managing Officer and the Compliance Officer be appointed as AML-Reporting Officer, each authorised to open corporate bank and Escrow accounts, execute shipyard construction contracts, and file all statutory returns under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014. RESOLVED that all actions taken in connection herewith be ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Registries (online portal: corporate registries)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search and reservation request through the Bermuda Registries online platform for the proposed exempted partnership name, appending 'LP' or 'Limited Partnership' as required. The Registrar verifies against the existing register of exempted partnerships and reserved corporate names; a reserved name may be held for 30 days pending application.
required_dossiers: Proposed partnership name (not less than two names in order of preference)
Brief description of intended business activity (ISIC 3011)
Identification of the proposed General Partner
Name reservation fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or conflicts with a registered entity, file a written objection with the Registrar within 14 days or submit alternative names on the same application without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Exempted Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda-qualified legal counsel and the General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage Bermuda counsel to draft the Exempted Partnership Agreement in accordance with the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014, addressing the capital contributions of Limited Partners, the distribution waterfall, indemnification provisions, management authority of the General Partner, assignment restrictions, and the dispute resolution mechanism. The Agreement must be executed by the General Partner and all Limited Partners before submission.
required_dossiers: Draft Limited Partnership Agreement
Certificate of incorporation of the corporate General Partner (if any)
Consent to act of the General Partner
Authority resolutions of the General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries any provision inconsistent with the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014, the parties shall execute an amendment deed to the Partnership Agreement and resubmit within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form 1 with Statutory Declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 - Application for Registration of an Exempted Partnership at the Registrar of Companies, accompanied by the executed Partnership Agreement, the General Partner's declaration of compliance, and the Limited Partners' declarations of non-resident status for exemption eligibility. The application shall be notarised where the signature of a non-resident partner is affixed abroad.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (signed by the General Partner)
Executed Exempted Partnership Agreement
Compliance declaration of the General Partner
Non-resident ownership declarations of Limited Partners
Certificate of good standing of the corporate General Partner (if foreign)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Registrar issues a query notice; the applicant must cure deficiencies by filing a supplementary declaration or amendment within 14 days, failing which the application is deemed withdrawn.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Registration Fee and Issuance of Certificate of Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Companies, Bermuda Registries (financial services window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon provisional acceptance of Form 1, pay the prescribed registration fee of USD 2,080 (BMD equivalent) via bank transfer to the Bermuda Government consolidated fund; the Registrar then issues the Certificate of Registration evidencing the legal existence of the Exempted Partnership.
required_dossiers: Provisional acceptance notice
Proof of funds transfer reference
Form 1 application reference number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is not reconciled, resubmit the SWIFT payment receipt and request a manual reconciliation; the Certificate is issued only after fee confirmation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Registered Office and Authorised Resident Representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notice of registered office address in Hamilton (mainland Bermuda) and the appointment of an Authorised Resident Representative as required under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2014; the authorised representative must be a local Bermuda resident licensed to accept service of process and shall maintain the partnership's statutory register at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Form of Notice of Registered Office
Consent to act of the Authorised Resident Representative
Local registered office address confirmation from the service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the representative declines or the address is invalid, submit an appointing-corporate-entity change form within 7 days; the Registrar will not record changes where outstanding fees remain.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Beneficial Ownership Filing and BMA Compliance Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority Registrar of Companies (beneficial ownership central register)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and file the beneficial ownership declaration with the Registrar for transmission to the Bermuda Monetary Authority, identifying all natural persons with ownership or control over the partnership interests (25% or greater) and the shipyard operating entity; no overseas activity approval is required for exempted status, but the beneficial ownership filing is mandatory within 21 days.
required_dossiers: Beneficial ownership register
Control structure diagram of the ELP
Passport copies of beneficial owners
Source of capital declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If BMA notifies a discrepancy, submit a corrective enhanced due diligence report through the General Partner within 10 business days; repeated non-compliance may incur a BMA penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Bank Escrow and Maritime Payment Rail Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Bermuda banks and EMI settlement providers (Bermuda Monetary Authority regulated)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate operating account and a segregated Escrow account in the ELP's name for maritime installment collections; provide the Certificate of Registration, Partnership Agreement, constitutional documents, and the beneficial ownership declaration to satisfy the bank's KYB and anti-financial-crime checks for Medium_Risk_Enhanced accounts supporting LC and Escrow rails.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Registration of the ELP
Exempted Partnership Agreement
Certificate of Incumbency and authorised signatories
Beneficial ownership declaration accepted by BMA
Banker's reference and principal identity documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On refusal or enhanced due diligence request, the ELP shall appoint a compliance consultant to prepare a remediation pack; the bank application may be re-submitted after provision of source-of-funds evidence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Marine and Ports Services, Ministry of Transport, Government of Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Shipyard Operations Licence and Marine Facilities Permit (pursuant to the Marine and Ports Authority Act 1986 and the Merchant Shipping Act 2002)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources, Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full EIA Report Required (Category A - Works likely to have significant adverse impacts on the marine environment and coastal zone)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges shall not exceed Bermuda Water Authority consent limits of pH 6-9, suspended solids <50 mg/L, and oil/grease <15 mg/L; VOCs emissions from surface coating shall comply with the Air Pollution Control Regulations; all sandblast and paint residue, anti-fouling hull scraping and wash water shall be captured, treated and disposed of in dedicated shore reception facilities in accordance with MARPOL Annex I waste oil handling provisions and the Bermuda Waste Management Regulations 2020

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service final fire safety certificate and occupancy load approval; structural load inspection and slipway certification by the Ministry of Public Works (Buildings Section); workplace hazard clearance and dockyard operational sign-off under the Bermuda Occupational Safety and Health Code of Practice (Work in Confined Spaces and NOHSC-like standards); welder certifications, crane load test certificates, and evacuation plans must be deposited with the Commissioner of Workforce Development

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Ministry of Finance — Office of the Tax Commissioner (OTC), the Registrar of Companies (Bermuda Business Register), and the Bermuda Customs Department (UNCTAD ASYCUDA World platform); UK HMRC retains authority only for any UK permanent establishment, UK source income or UK-seated partners, while Bermuda itself is outside the UK VAT and UK corporation tax territory.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP): (1) appoint a Bermuda-licensed legal/corporate services provider; (2) file the declaration of limited partnership with the Registrar of Companies under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 with the statutory application fee; (3) obtain the Certificate of Registration carrying the permanent ELP registration number, which functions as the TIN-equivalent for banking, customs and tax filings; (4) apply to the Minister of Finance for non-resident partnership status where business will not be carried on in Bermuda; (5) register for payroll tax and social insurance with the OTC only if the ELP has Bermuda employees; (6) register with Bermuda Customs as an exporter/shipyard declarant and enrol for ASYCUDA World electronic filing; no general income-tax TIN is issued because exempted partnerships are outside Bermuda income tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible — a Bermuda ELP is fiscally transparent by default: no entity-level Bermuda income/corporation tax; profits, losses and credits flow through to partners under the limited partnership agreement; pass-through is automatic unless (a) the partnership affirmatively elects corporate classification under U.S. check-the-box rules, or (b) the partnership is a flow-through constituent entity of an MNE group with consolidated revenue above the Bermuda CIT Act 2023 threshold (EUR 750m), in which case the 15% qualified domestic minimum top-up tax may apply to its Bermuda profits.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (a) Non-resident partnership election under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (tax and exchange-control neutrality for offshore activities); (b) U.S. Form 8832 check-the-box election to treat the ELP as a corporation or disregarded entity for U.S. federal tax purposes; (c) UK hybrid-mismatch neutralisation positions under TIOPA 2010 Part 6A where UK partners are involved; (d) Bermuda CIT Act 2023 elections, including QDMTT safe-harbour calculations, IIR/UTPR entity designations and flow-through allocation statements for in-scope multinational groups.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None — Bermuda imposes no VAT, GST or sales and use tax; indirect taxation is limited to customs import duty (Customs Act 1960 and tariff), stamp duty on specific instruments and payroll tax; UK VAT at 20% does not apply to supplies made in or from Bermuda and arises only when a UK customer imports the finished vessel into the UK.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — there is no VAT/GST registration threshold in Bermuda; customs duty is charged per importation on consumption and may be zero-rated for qualifying industrial inputs used by a licensed commercial shipyard; the economic turnover trigger for Bermuda CIT registration is EUR 750m annual consolidated group revenue in at least one of the two preceding fiscal years.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Electronic customs clearance is mandatory through the Bermuda Customs automated system built on UNCTAD ASYCUDA World; all exports, including ocean container vessels cleared from the shipyard, require an approved electronic export declaration filed before departure; there is no real-time fiscal invoice clearance, continuous transaction control, or digital stamping of invoices in Bermuda, and B2B invoicing remains free-format under the common law.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable as VAT zero-rating because Bermuda has no VAT. Exports of newly built ocean container vessels, components and construction services from Bermuda are outside the scope of Bermuda indirect taxation, so no output tax is charged. A customs duty drawback and 0% industrial input rate are available: import duty paid on components incorporated into a vessel exported to a non-Bermuda customer is refunded under the drawback provisions of the Customs Act 1960, provided the ELP holds a shipyard licence, identifies the duty-paid inputs in the vessel cost build-up, and files the complete export bundle within 12 months of the vessel's departure. UK-side VAT arises only in the hands of the UK purchaser on importation at 20% (with possible reliefs), never as a Bermuda export charge.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: ASYCUDA World electronic Customs Export Declaration (pre-departure filing with customs reference number)
Original or certified negotiable Bill of Lading (or sea waybill where short-sea/highway feeder)
Inward remittance certificate or bank payment evidence from LC/escrow settlement
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list identifying shipyard inputs
Import entry and duty payment records supporting the drawback computation
Certificate of deletion or export from the Bermuda Registry of Ships for the delivered vessel
Shipyard licence reference and owner's attestation of final destination outside Bermuda
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Bermuda Customs and the Ministry of Finance may audit export and drawback claims for a statutory limitation period, extended indefinitely where fraud or false statements are evidenced. Consequences include: retrospective clawback of every duty drawback received, payment of three times the duty evaded, penalties of up to BMD 1,000 per false declaration plus forfeiture of goods/vessel value, and suspension or revocation of the licensed shipyard status; for in-scope MNE groups, misstatements in CIT Act 2023 QDMTT filings carry up to 100% of the tax underpaid as penalty and are reportable to UK HMRC under exchange-of-information arrangements; corporate-service-provider and AML enforcement under the Bermuda Proceeds of Crime Act can add substantial fines and disqualification of the general partner. The 180-day inward remittance window applies to the consideration for the exported vessel and must be evidenced by the inward remittance certificate retained in the customs file.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), acting as the monetary authority and exchange control administrator for Bermuda under the Exchange Control Act 1972
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Bermuda operates a currency-board-style peg of BMD 1:1 to USD. Current account transactions are freely convertible and capital account transactions by non-resident entities are generally unrestricted. Profit remittance and dividend distributions by a non-resident Exempted Limited Partnership may be made without prior exchange control approval provided that the underlying capital was introduced from outside Bermuda and the entity maintains current beneficial ownership declarations and audited accounts. Resident entities may require specific or general permission from the BMA for certain capital transfers, but a non-resident ELP is treated as outside the scope of most exchange control restrictions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda does not impose a statutory export proceeds surrender regime. The Exchange Control Act 1972 and subsidiary regulations contain no mandatory conversion timeline and no compulsory conversion ratio for export receipts. A non-resident ELP may retain 100% of export proceeds in any permitted currency without obligation to convert into BMD or USD. For resident entities, the BMA may attach conditions to exchange control approvals, but no automatic surrender obligation exists for shipbuilding export earnings.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Trade Finance Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Low-Medium. Legal Constraints: Bermuda does not maintain a distinct Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licence. Fintech payment providers must either obtain a banking licence under the Banks and Deposit Companies Act 1999 or register as a money service business under the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2018. UK or EU EMI passports do not extend to Bermuda. A BMA-licensed entity is required for regulated deposit-taking or money transmission. For pre-funded escrow payments, a third-party licensed payment provider may be used as a pass-through conduit, but the ELP must maintain its primary treasury accounts at a fully licensed Bermuda bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a medium-risk enhanced shipyard ELP, at least one general partner and the ultimate beneficial owner must normally attend a physical onboarding interview at the bank's Bermuda office. Remote onboarding is not standard and is permitted only on an exceptional basis through an approved digital KYC programme, subject to heightened due diligence, independent verification by a notary or regulated attorney, and written approval from the bank's Money Laundering Reporting Officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds opacity for large capital contributions from non-resident limited partners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements, bank confirmation letters, tax returns, executed partnership capital contribution schedules, board or general partner resolutions, source-of-wealth statement, and an independent legal opinion confirming the lawful origin of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between the registered office address and the operational shipyard location.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified lease or ownership documentation, utility bills, statutory register of directors and partners, physical inspection report, corporate group structure chart, and a notarized confirmation of the ELP's place of effective management.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to sanctioned jurisdictions or high-risk maritime counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export and import licences, denied-party screening outputs, complete counterparty list, Incoterms-based commercial contracts, ICC trade registration records, and a compliance attestation issued by independent maritime trade counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained high transaction velocity expected through milestone-linked letter of credit draws.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed shipbuilding contract, milestone payment schedule, projected cash-flow statement, escrow agreement, letter of credit terms, and an independent marine engineering verification report confirming construction progress.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be routed as SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers or MT202 cover payments to the ELP's USD account held at a Bermuda bank. USD clearing is effected through Fedwire or CHIPS using the bank's correspondent network. The payment narrative must identify the transfer as 'Capital Contribution – ELP Equity' and include the partnership registration number. Pre-verification requires SWIFT sanctions screening, BMA reporting checks, and reconciliation against the executed capital commitment schedule. A non-resident ELP does not require prior BMA approval for an inbound capital contribution; the bank will, however, hold a BMA-completed declaration form that identifies all ultimate beneficial owners.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements should be executed through SWIFT MT103 direct transfers for supplier payments and through commercial letters of credit issued via SWIFT MT700 or MT710 for documentary trade finance. Maritime installment payments should use a Commercial LC with a vessel identification reference and invoice number. A standby letter of credit or demand guarantee may be issued under MT760 in favour of the shipyard to secure progress payments. Where milestone conditions apply, distributions should be routed through a dual-signature escrow account with a pre-agreed disbursement schedule verified by the bank's transaction monitoring system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for currencies without offshore deliverability
European-style FX options and zero-cost put/call spreads

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Limited Partnership Annual Return and Declaration (ELPA 2015, s.49)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary of the date of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late submission triggers an administrative penalty of BMD 250; continued default beyond 90 days after formal notice permits the Registrar to strike the partnership off the Register and dissolve it under s.53 of the ELPA 2015.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business Licence Renewal (Business Licence Act 2014; minimum fee based on assessable gross receipts)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, Business Licensing Section, Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 November each year for the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to renew by the statutory date is an offence punishable by a fine of up to BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per day for continuing non-compliance; the entity may be prohibited from carrying on business in or from Bermuda.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Re-Confirmation (AML/ATF Code of Practice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (through the designated registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the registration anniversary, submitted together with the ELP Annual Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with beneficial ownership confirmation obligations may result in monetary penalties of up to BMD 20,000 and/or imprisonment of up to 2 years for materially false declarations under the AML/ATF Regulations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit is imposed by the Exempted Limited Partnerships Act 2015 for private ELPs. An independent audit is compulsory only if (i) the partnership agreement expressly requires it, (ii) the entity is subject to BMA prudential supervision, or (iii) the ELP is listed on a recognised stock exchange.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB are the primary framework accepted in Bermuda; US GAAP is also acceptable provided it is applied consistently and disclosed.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Companies and Limited Partnerships (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018, the General Partner must formally re-confirm to the registered agent all beneficial ownership particulars on an annual basis, including any changes in voting rights or profit entitlements. The confirmation must be kept on file and produced to the Registrar of Companies or BMA upon request.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of the General Partner

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% on Bermuda-sourced and worldwide income for qualifying Exempted Limited Partnerships (ELPs); 15% domestic Corporate Income Tax (CIT) applies only to constituent entities of in-scope multinational groups with consolidated group revenue of EUR 750 million or more, effective for fiscal years commencing on or after 1 January 2025 (Income Tax Act 2024).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No capital gains tax, no payroll tax for ELP exempted business, no branch profits tax, and no stamp duty on partnership capital contributions. ELP qualifies for a time-limited tax exemption certificate (under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2021) protecting from future Bermuda income, capital, profits, and estate taxes until 31 March 2035 (renewable). Shipyard manufacturing profits are outside Bermuda's territorial nexus and are structurally offshore; no preferential CIT rate exists because the base rate is already zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: ELP Annual Return — Form AR-ELP, filed electronically via the Bermuda Registrar of Companies Online Filing System (Registry e-Services ['comCIPHER' Bermuda Registry Portal]).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 60 calendar days after each anniversary of the ELP's date of registration in Bermuda.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempted Limited Partnership legal name and registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact name as registered; verify prior 'Name Reservation Certificate' to avoid mismatch.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Bermuda (must be the address of the resident representative / approved service provider).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ELPs must maintain a physical registered office; a P.O. box alone is non-compliant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and addresses of all general partners, limited partners (with capital contributions), and the Bermuda-resident principal representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose non-resident partners individually; a nominee filing requires a signed declaration of ultimate beneficial ownership.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Summary of partnership business activities and sector classification (ISIC / NAICS code).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For 'ISIC 3011' insert 'Commercial deep-sea container vessel shipbuilding and repair'; confirm no Bermuda nexus activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the ELP Annual Return attracts a default fine of BMD 500, plus a continuing penalty of BMD 100 per month; persistent non-filing leads to automatic administrative strike-off of the ELP and loss of the 2035 tax exemption certificate.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Economic Substance Declaration — Form ESD-1, filed through the Bermuda Tax Administration Secure Online Portal (unique ELP taxpayer ID).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before 30 June following the end of the ELP's financial reporting period (or 6 months from fiscal year-end, whichever date falls later).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Relevant Activity Classification — identify if the ELP is engaged in any ESR Relevant Activity (banking, insurance, fund management, financing/leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution/service centre, IP holding, pure equity holding).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A shipbuilding (ISIC 3011) manufacturing operation is NOT an ESR Relevant Activity unless the ELP also conducts 'shipping' (international vessel operation) or 'holding business' as a pure equity holding entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Basis of tax residence — confirm whether the ELP is Bermuda tax resident or non-resident for ESR purposes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ELPs must attach a statement of foreign tax residence (e.g., UK or Hong Kong tax residency certificate) to be outside ESR scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core Income Generating Activities (CIGA) — narrative disclosure of where shipyard contracts, slipway operations, and vessel construction activities are performed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm all CIGA for shipbuilding are performed outside Bermuda; if conducted in Bermuda, describe local employees, premises, and annual expenditure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Qualified expenditure and headcount in Bermuda (BMD).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter '0' for both fields if the non-resident ELP has no Bermudian staff or operating premises; gross negligence in this field attracts false-declaration penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the ESD-1 attracts an immediate civil penalty of BMD 6,000; a false or misleading declaration attracts a fine of BMD 84,000 and confirmation of the entity as a 'shell company' by the Registrar, exposing the ELP to dissolution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Return — Form CIT-1 (Bermuda CIT e-Filing Portal), applicable only to constituent entities of in-scope MNE groups (EUR 750M+ consolidated revenue).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than 15 months after the end of the ELP's fiscal year under the Income Tax Act 2024; transitional in-scope groups' first filing due 15 months after their first in-scope fiscal year-end (e.g., for a 31 December 2025 year-end, due 31 March 2027).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total group revenues attributable to the Bermuda ELP, including maritime construction milestone payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report on a CIT country-by-country basis; if the shipyard and vessel sales are booked offshore, the ELP only includes Bermuda-sourced revenues.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of cross-border transactions with affiliates (vessel components, IP royalties, management fees, financing).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply arm's length standard and OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines; attach a Schedule B-1 listing each related counterparty jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of payroll and tangible asset carve-outs (5% for tangible assets, 5% payroll) that reduce GloBE/Elligible Income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Shipyard physical assets located abroad are generally not eligible assets for Bermuda SBIE; exclude them.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 15% top-up tax computation after QDMTT / GloBE credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bermuda's Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax (DMTT) may apply to in-scope ELPs; file the DMTT return module simultaneously.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late CIT return: fixed penalty of BMD 10,000 plus BMD 1,000 per month; inaccurate return: penalty equal to 100% of the understated tax for deliberate error; interest accrues at BMD base rate plus 2% per annum.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Bermuda levies no statutory withholding tax on distributions, dividends, or partnership profit remittances to non-resident partners (including the shipyard ELP's limited partners).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Bermuda has no comprehensive double tax agreement; only Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs) and the US-UK Income Tax Treaty (extended to Bermuda for certain limited US tax exemptions). Protocol: (1) submit a Bermuda Tax Residence Certificate (Form TRC-BM) to the Bermuda Registrar of Taxes proving zero-tax residence; (2) file a UK 'Form DT-Bermuda' with HM Revenue & Customs to evidence that no UK deemed PE arises from the Bermuda ELP; (3) claim US treaty benefits (if applicable) via IRS Form W-8BEN-E with reference to the US-UK-Bermuda arrangement; (4) retain supporting banking records for installment letters of credit and escrow proceeds for 7 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT on IP royalties and debt interest: 0% for both Bermuda-sourced and pass-through payments. Under US-UK treaty extension, a Bermuda-resident ELP is eligible for 0% US-interest WHT (passive interest) and 0% royalty WHT (copyrights/industrial royalties); the Bermudian bank or London conduit must be the registered beneficial owner to claim the exemption, accompanied by a valid US TIN of the ELP.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: BMD 0 (no general threshold for local filing); however, for in-scope MNE groups (EUR 750M+), contemporaneous Master File and Local File documentation is mandatory for all intercompany transactions with Bermudian constituent entities regardless of transaction size. Unless the shipyard ELP exceeds BMD 10 million in related-party purchases or BMD 5 million in related-party sales, no simplified TP documentation is locally accepted; the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines apply directly under the Income Tax Act 2024.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) — preferred for vessel hull steel, marine diesels, and spare component sales
Cost Plus Method — appropriate for shipyard fabrication and subassembly services
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) — most appropriate for the ELP acting as holding and financing principal
Profit Split Method — recommended for joint vessel design and IP-sharing arrangements with foreign shipyards
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Economic Substance (Bermuda) Regulations 2018 apply; 'Relevant Activities' include banking, insurance, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping (international vessel operation), distribution and service centres, intellectual property holding, and pure equity holding. Commercial container-vessel shipbuilding (ISIC 3011) is NOT a listed Relevant Activity; the ELP must nonetheless maintain sufficient real presence in Bermuda for its registered-office and administrative functions. If the ELP also holds ship-owning subsidiaries (chartering), the 'pure equity holding' and 'shipping' activities become Relevant, requiring full economic substance (board meetings, senior management, CIGA, and adequate expenditure in Bermuda).

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of Bermuda CIT liability by excluding related-party income of the vessel construction group, backdating fund flow from escrow accounts, or fabricating SBIE payroll/tangible asset applications for assets located in foreign shipyards.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of up to 150% of the tax liability; criminal prosecution under the Income Tax Act 2024 with fines up to BMD 1,000,000; in the case of false sworn declarations to the Bermuda Registrar, a fine of BMD 84,000 and imprisonment not exceeding 5 years under the Criminal Code Act 1907.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Partners and directors of the ELP's management entity are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid CIT and penalties if they authorized the false return; a Director Disqualification Order and a travel ban may be issued pending restitution of tax and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: ELP claims shipping or pure equity holding status but conducts no CIGA in Bermuda, holds no board meetings, and has zero Bermudian employees or expenditure; alternatively, the ELP files ESD-1 with materially incomplete line items to conceal its foreign shipyard management role.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar's declaration of the ELP as a shell company; mandatory strike-off and dissolution; monetary penalty of BMD 250,000 plus BMD 10,000 per day of continuing non-compliance; referral to the UK Secretary of State for sanctions under the Overseas Sanctions Regulations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly allow the filing of false substance declarations are personally liable for penalties up to BMD 250,000; the Supreme Court of Bermuda may order restitution of all profits earned through the sham, seizure of the ELP's bank account, and a 10-year travel ban.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Acceptance of maritime installment letters of credit or escrow payments from vessel purchasers without customer due diligence, or failure to disclose beneficial owners of the ELP in the Beneficial Ownership Secure Search system within 19 days of any charge (including non-resident shipowner funders).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Proceeds of Crime (Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing) Regulations 2008 — civil penalty up to BMD 200,000, criminal fine up to BMD 5,000,000, and imprisonment up to 10 years; the ELP's license as a shipbuilder and its operating bank account may be suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A general partner who signs off a suspicious maritime transaction report late is personally liable for a daily penalty of BMD 500; on indictment, directors face forfeiture of personal assets obtained from the transaction and a 7-year custodial sentence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Statutory Non-Compliance and Untrue Declarations to the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the ELP Annual Return or ESD-1 for consecutive years, or making a false statement as to the ELP's registered address, partners, or intended 2035 tax exemption status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Default fine BMD 500 plus BMD 100 monthly; automatic administrative dissolution after 13 months of non-filing (Exempted Partnerships Act 2021); re-registration requires a Supreme Court order with costs against the ELP.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Any director or general partner knowingly submitting a false annual return is liable to BMD 84,000 fine and 4 years imprisonment; the court may order the individual to compensate all third-party creditors for debts incurred while the ELP was in default.
